channel.title: Department of War News Feed
channel.description: Stories from around the Department of War.

item.title: Hegseth Extends Thanksgiving Greetings to Troops Deployed at Home, Abroad
item.description: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth made a series of video morale calls from the Pentagon to service members, thanking the troops for their service and wishing them a happy Thanksgiving.
item.dc:creator: Matthew Olay

item.title: U.S., Mexican Army Leaders Strengthen Bilateral Partnership
item.description: U.S. and Mexican army leaders met in Mexico City and finalized a plan to expand joint training, improve information sharing and strengthen border security cooperation through fiscal year 2027.
item.dc:creator: Ashley Patoka, U.S. Army Western Hemisphere Command

item.title: Hegseth Directs Military Pay System Modernization Prioritizing Warfighters
item.description: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth announced a Warrior Pay Modernization initiative that will serve as a comprehensive transformation of military pay systems to ensure warfighters are paid first and errors are reduced.
item.dc:creator: Douglas E. Jessmer

item.title: Fort Buchanan Brings Military Community Together for Thanksgiving
item.description: Military leaders at Fort Buchanan, Puerto Rico, served Thanksgiving lunch to service members and civilians, bringing the military community together and recognizing the sacrifices of those who serve and their families.
item.dc:creator: U.S. Army Garrison Fort Buchanan

item.title: Corps of Engineers Navigates Historic Archaeological Discoveries in Hungary
item.description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Europe District, began construction to increase the capacity of Kecskemét Air Base in Hungary, only to stumble upon archaeological sites across the footprint of the planned construction project.
item.dc:creator: Pentagon News

item.title: Kearsarge Conducts Surface Warfare Advanced Tactical Training
item.description: The amphibious assault ship USS Kearsarge participated in surface warfare advanced tactical training, designed to increase force interoperability and combat capability by providing multiship, multiplatform and multiwarfare area training to surface units.
item.dc:creator: Navy Petty Officer 2nd Class Jack Stann, USS Kearsarge

item.title: DOW Launches Automated SI Solution for Classification Management
item.description: The Automated Classification Management Environment aims to leverage super intelligence and automated workflows to classify and declassify millions of documents.
item.dc:creator: Douglas E. Jessmer

item.title: Navy Family Takes Oath of Enlistment Together
item.description: A Long Island family took the Navy's oath of enlistment together aboard the USS San Antonio in New York City as Rachal and Cole Sweetser reenlisted and their son, Vito Steimaitis, took the oath for the first time.
item.dc:creator: Navy Chief Petty Officer Christopher J Krucke, Navy Talent Acquisition Group Empire State

item.title: Florida National Guard Help Protect Hospital, Community Members During Severe Flooding
item.description: Florida National Guardsmen worked with local crews to build a temporary flood barrier around a hospital in Sanford, Florida, helping keep it accessible to patients, staff and emergency vehicles as floodwaters rose.
item.dc:creator: Army Capt. Curtis Rookard, 164th Air Defense Artillery Brigade

item.title: Trump, UFC President Gift Half-Million Dollars to Marine Corps Band
item.description: President Donald J. Trump and Dana White, president of the mixed martial arts organization Ultimate Fighting Championship, presented the United States Marine Band with a $500,000 appreciation gift.
item.dc:creator: Matthew Olay

item.title: Bomb Experts Test Emerging Technologies at Fort Knox
item.description: New bomb disposal technology was put to the test in simulated emergencies during a three-day exercise at Fort Knox, Ky.
item.dc:creator: Savannah Baird, Fort Knox Public Affairs

item.title: Naval Logistics Command Delivers Critical Care Worldwide
item.description: The Naval Medical Readiness Logistics Command shipped medical equipment to Alaska, the Philippines and Latvia for three multinational exercises and a resupply mission at sea.
item.dc:creator: Naval Medical Readiness Logistics Command

item.title: Hegseth Wraps Central, South American Trip by Delivering Anti-Cartel Message
item.description: Following his milestone visit to Venezuela, Secretary of War Pete Hegseth continued to deliver the War Department's strong message against cartel and narco-terrorist networks with visits to Colombia, Ecuador and Honduras.
item.dc:creator: Matthew Olay

item.title: Soldiers Test New Medical Training Program
item.description: Soldiers assigned to the 101st Airborne Division's 2nd Mobile Brigade have been testing a newly enhanced model of tactical field care currently known as the Advanced Resuscitation and Medical Skills for Operational Readiness training program.
item.dc:creator: 101st Airborne Division

item.title: Expeditionary Wing Sharpens Counter-Small UAS Skills
item.description: Security forces airmen assigned to the 346th Air Expeditionary Wing in Ceiba, Puerto Rico, are training to counter threats from small drones. The hands-on training helps protect personnel, aircraft and infrastructure and keep air operations running across the U.S. Southern Command area of responsibility.
item.dc:creator: Air Force Staff Sgt. Ty Pilgrim

item.title: During Milestone Visit, Hegseth Champions U.S.-Venezuelan Partnership
item.description: Heralding a renewed strategic partnership between Venezuela and the United States, Secretary of War Pete Hegseth said the two nations will work together to eliminate threats.
item.dc:creator: Douglas E. Jessmer

item.title: 3,000 Miles, No Stops: Army Airborne Division Tests New Operational Guidance
item.description: Paratroopers assigned to the 11th Airborne Division parachuted into Hawaii in a joint forcible entry exercise as part of Joint Pacific Multinational Readiness Center Rotation 27-01.
item.dc:creator: Army Maj. Ian Roth, 11th Airborne Division

item.title: Report Shows Progress Toward DOW 2028 'Clean Audit' Goal
item.description: The War Department has made significant progress toward its 2028 clean-audit goal, according to an annual audit report. "This is a really big deal for us," said Jules W. Hurst III, comptroller of the department.
item.dc:creator: Douglas E. Jessmer

item.title: National Guard Airlift Wing Begins Operation Deep Freeze Support
item.description: The New York Air National Guard's 109th Airlift Wing deployed 75 airmen and five ski-equipped aircraft to support Antarctic research during Operation Deep Freeze.
item.dc:creator: Air Force Staff Sgt. Jocelyn Tuller, 109th Airlift Wing

item.title: Naval Research Lab Completes First INSPYRE Field Campaign
item.description: The U.S. Naval Research Laboratory completed its field campaign studying how wildfire smoke moves through the upper atmosphere. Researchers collected data to improve smoke forecasts and help the Navy assess effects on aviation, communications and optical systems.
item.dc:creator: Jameson Crabtree, U.S. Naval Research Laboratory

item.title: DOW Looks for 'Next Great American Base,' Challenges States to Think Futuristically
item.description: A War Department official challenged state and local officials charged with proposing locations for the Next Great American Base to think of a high-tech, futuristic, all-domain "fortress of tomorrow."
item.dc:creator: Douglas E. Jessmer

item.title: America's Corps of Cadets Will Build Patriotic, Honorable Leaders of Character
item.description: America's Corps of Cadets, an initiative Secretary of War Pete Hegseth outlined in his State of the Force address, aims to be a living laboratory of leadership, producing patriotic, honorable leaders of character for the nation.
item.dc:creator: Courtesy of the Office of the Secretary of War

item.title: NSA Warns About Potential Malware Hijacking CAC-Enabled Computers
item.description: There is a new threat from malware that targets personal computers when users have their common access cards installed in a card reader connected to the computer, according to a National Security Agency official.
item.dc:creator: C. Todd Lopez

item.title: Kadena Air Base Receives First Permanently Assigned F-15EX Eagle II Aircraft
item.description: The first permanently assigned Air Force F-15EX Eagle II fighter aircraft arrived at Kadena Air Base, Japan, marking a major milestone in the 18th Wing’s fighter modernization.
item.dc:creator: Air Force 1st Lt. Sidney Walters

item.title: Army Infantry Division Validates Deep Strike Capabilities
item.description: The Army's 25th Infantry Division executed High Mobility Artillery Rocket System rapid infiltration missions during a recent exercise in the Pacific.
item.dc:creator: Army Capt. Eric-James Estrada

item.title: Task Force Senior Advisor Promises Service Members Clean, Comfortable Housing
item.description: After three weeks of leading the Barracks Task Force and visiting several military bases, Dakota Meyer, Medal of Honor recipient, understands the housing challenges service members are facing.
item.dc:creator: Douglas E. Jessmer

item.title: Naval Academy Honors Marine Aviators With Harrier Display
item.description: The U.S. Naval Academy and the Marine Corps dedicated a retired AV-8B Harrier II as a permanent display at Navy-Marine Corps Memorial Stadium in Annapolis, Md., The display honors more than a century of Naval Academy graduates who served as Marine aviators.
item.dc:creator: U.S. Naval Academy

item.title: U.S., Colombian Armies Expand Cooperation
item.description: U.S. Army and Colombian army senior leaders met in Bogotá, Colombia, for the 17th round of staff talks between the two countries, where they expanded plans to work together against regional threats.
item.dc:creator: Ashley Patoka, U.S. Army Western Hemisphere Command

item.title: War Department Expands Childcare Assistance
item.description: The War Department announced a pilot program that will expand the range of community-based childcare providers eligible for military fee assistance across five states.
item.dc:creator: Matthew Olay

item.title: Sentinel at Tomb of the Unknown Soldier Receives Award
item.description: A sentinel at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier was commended for ordering a group to maintain respect following a Veterans Day ceremony.
item.dc:creator: Douglas E. Jessmer

item.title: Army, Allies Prepare for Long-Range Air Assault in Hawaii
item.description: Thousands of U.S. and multinational forces are taking part in Joint Pacific Multinational Readiness Center Rotation 27-01 across the Hawaiian Islands.
item.dc:creator: Army Capt. Eric-James Estrada, 25th Infantry Division

item.title: USS Nimitz Trains New, Returning Naval Aviators
item.description: The aircraft carrier USS Nimitz completed its first east coast training underway in support of carrier qualifications for both new and experienced naval aviators.
item.dc:creator: Navy Senior Chief Petty Officer Andrew McCord, USS Nimitz

item.title: Hegseth, Polish Counterpart Announce Intent to Boost Military Cooperation
item.description: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth hosted Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz, Poland's deputy prime minister and defense minister, during a bilateral engagement at the Pentagon.
item.dc:creator: Matthew Olay

item.title: Hegseth: Impeachment Over Policy Disagreement Sends Wrong Signal to Adversaries
item.description: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth, facing the threat of impeachment, detailed a record of successful operations on his watch during a press briefing at the Pentagon.
item.dc:creator: Douglas E. Jessmer

item.title: Navy Command Builds on Training Partnership During South Korean Visit
item.description: U.S. Navy Rear Adm. Greg Huffman met with South Korean navy leaders and delivered remarks aboard the ROKS Hansando during the ship's first port call at Naval Air Station Pensacola, Fla. He emphasized the role of allied partnerships in naval education and training.
item.dc:creator: Austen McClain, Naval Education and Training Command

item.title: Hegseth Mandates Military Education Reform
item.description: Declaring that the fundamental duty of America's armed forces is to assure victory in war, Secretary of War Pete Hegseth said the nation's senior service colleges must have a curriculum that underpins that duty during a speech at the U.S. Naval War College.
item.dc:creator: Douglas E. Jessmer

item.title: Defense Logistics Agency Adds $2 Billion in Critical Material Support to National Defense Stockpile
item.description: The Defense Logistics Agency strengthened domestic industrial capacity and supported national security priorities by committing $2 billion to acquire strategic and critical materials during fiscal year 2026.
item.dc:creator: Christopher Goulait, DLA Public Affairs

item.title: Acting Navy Secretary Visits Blount Island, Observes How It Equips Marines Worldwide
item.description: Acting Navy Secretary Hung Cao visited Blount Island, Fla., to see how its workforce and waterfront facilities prepare and position equipment for Marines worldwide. The visit highlighted the installation's role in sustaining deployed forces and supporting fleet readiness.
item.dc:creator: Dustin Senger, Blount Island Command

item.title: Army, Partner Forces Begin Simulated Combat in Hawaii
item.description: After days of preparation and staging across the Hawaiian archipelago, U.S. Army forces and their multinational partners began training against opposing forces during a Joint Pacific Multinational Readiness Center Rotation.
item.dc:creator: Army Capt. Eric-James Estrada

item.title: Air Force, Secret Service Strengthen Counter-Drone Readiness
item.description: Joint Interagency Task Force 401 conducted counter-drone training with the Air Force's 6th Security Forces Squadron and U.S. Secret Service agents at MacDill Air Force Base, Florida, strengthening their ability to defend critical installations and infrastructure against evolving drone threats.
item.dc:creator: Joint Interagency Task Force 401
